trap.label: therefore ≠ so
trap.wrong: The fee is high, therefore, so we offer plans.
trap.right: The fee is high; therefore, we offer plans.
trap.why: O brasileiro junta dois conectores de consequência. Use apenas um.

opts: First of all, then, we plan.
Firstly, we plan. Secondly, we act.

fix.wrong: It was hard, however we won.
fix.right: It was hard; however, we won.

fix.wrong: In addition of this, we help.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com furthermore: “It is cheap. It is fast. (add)”
rewrite.answer: It is cheap; furthermore, it is fast.
